verdict.rationale: incident.io's marketing page says it offers 'public and private Status Pages' for communicating with customers, so private status pages appear to exist. Nothing in the evidence describes how access is controlled, or whether pages can be scoped to specific customers or to employees only. missing for 10: documentation of access-control mechanisms (SSO/auth, allowlists), customer-specific audience pages, employee-only internal status page configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
